fields.Body:
View a summary of the updates.Microsoft [https://images.ecomm.microsoft.com/cdn/mediahandler/azure-emails-templates/production/shared/images/templates/shared/microsoft-2x.png] [https://images.ecomm.microsoft.com/cdn/mediahandler/azure-emails-templates/production/shared/images/templates/shared/images/icons/status-info-gray.png] As a new admin to the Microsoft 365 admin center, you’ll get weekly emails from the message center about upcoming changes to your services until September 6, 2025. Update your preferences to continue getting emails like this one. Go to preferences [https://nam.safelink.emails.azure.net/redirect/?destination=https%3A%2F%2Fadmin.microsoft.com%2FAdminPortal%2Fhome%23%2FMessageCenter%2F%3A%2Fmcpreferences&p=bT0xOWM3ODkxOS0wM2JiLTQzNTgtOTA0Mi0zYzc3NjU0NGFkZWUmdT1hZW8mbD1ob21l]

MESSAGE CENTER ANNOUNCEMENTS
AUGUST 11, 2025 - AUGUST 17, 2025
NPCSERVICES.COM.AU

MAJOR UPDATES
[https://static2.sharepointonline.com/files/fabric-cdn-prod_20200821.001/assets/brand-icons/product-monoline/png/admin_96x1.png] Streamlined file preview experience in Microsoft 365 Copilot app for iOS

MC1136042 | August 15 - Microsoft 365 Copilot iOS app will offer file previews and Copilot Chat for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files starting September 15, 2025, on iPhone, with editing moved to standalone apps. Similar updates will follow for iPad. Users will see prompts to install or open standalone apps for editing.
View more [https://nam.safelink.emails.azure.net/redirect/?destination=https%3A%2F%2Fadmin.microsoft.com%2FAdminPortal%2Fhome%23%2FMessageCenter%2F%3A%2Fmessages%2FMC1136042%3FMCLinkSource%3DDigestMail&p=bT0xOWM3ODkxOS0wM2JiLTQzNTgtOTA0Mi0zYzc3NjU0NGFkZWUmdT1hZW8mbD1ob21lXzI%3D]
